test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Horses for courses

options.text: Horses are mainly bred for race courses and are winners
The same horse can run in different race courses in order to win
Different people are suited for different jobs
The same person can do many jobs and give good results

solution:
The correct answer is **Different people are suited for different jobs.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is :
 
• **Horses for courses - **Different people are suited for different jobs and things.
 
 
• ​**Example: ***The choice of method is a matter for horses for courses.*__
 
 
 
• ​Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__****

__
 
• ** **दिए गए मुहावरे का सबसे उपयुक्त अर्थ है:
 
• Horses for courses - अलग-अलग लोग अलग-अलग काम और चीजों के लिए उपयुक्त होते हैं।
 
 
• **उदाहरण: ***The choice of method is a matter for horses for courses.*__
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर** विकल्प 3 **है।__*​*__
